entities.name: Muteesa I of Buganda

entities.summary: Muteesa I Mukaabya Walugembe Kayiira was the 30th Kabaka of the Kingdom of Buganda, from 1856 until 1884. His name is also spelt as Mtesa, M'tesa and as Mutesa.
